name: BrightHire
description: Retrieve and analyze hiring data, including scheduled interview context and prep materials, AI-generated notes and post-interview summaries, interviewer scorecards and candidate assessments from your ATS (e.g., Greenhouse), structured interview guides with questions and competencies, and job descriptions for open positions.

_published_faq.name: How do I add BrightHire to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add BrightHire to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.brighthire.ai/mcp/v1. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the BrightHire MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: BrightHire provides these MCP tools: search, get_scheduled_interviews, get_interview_context, get_interview_summary, get_call_ai_notes, get_transcripts, get_candidate_summary, get_scorecards, get_job_description, get_interview_guide, and get_coaching_report.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to BrightHire?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to BrightHire in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
BrightHire requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
BrightHire is developed by BrightHire. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
